lesson: Review P1 (all three lenses): blocks execute against whichever budget batch is active at their own time, so the atomic outline pin can diverge. backend/src/sql is OUT of scope, so fix in the service: re-read the active budget outline (batch id) AFTER the blocks execute and compare with the id pinned before; on any mismatch (or a block-reported budget batch id differing from the pin) return the existing 'refresh-required' outcome instead of a statement. Extend the race-shaped hermetic leaf to swap the batch between the pin and the block execution and assert refresh-required.
